mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, client_id AS clientId, trainer_id AS trainerId, lesson_count AS lessonCount, price, status FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, client_id, trainer_id, lesson_count, price, status ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{clientId}, #{trainerId}, #{lessonCount}, #{price}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS paymentId, p.user_name AS clientName, p.payment_price AS price, p.payment_fee AS platformFee, (p.payment_price - p.payment_fee) AS netAmount, p.status AS status, p.method AS method, DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS paymentDate, DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_date, '%H:%i') AS paymentTime FROM PAYMENT p WHERE p.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND p.payment_type = 'PT' ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC
